--- a/minbpe/base.py
+++ b/minbpe/base.py
@@ -41,28 +41,45 @@
-    p0, p1 = pair
-    # jump between occurrences of pair[0] with list.index (in C) and copy the
-    # untouched runs in between with slices; k = occurrences of p0 left at >= i
-    k = ids.count(p0)
-    if not k:
-        return list(ids)
-    newids = []

-    append = newids.append
-    index = ids.index
-    last = len(ids) - 1
-    same = p0 == p1
-    i = 0
-    while k:
-        j = index(p0, i)
-        k -= 1
-        # if not at the very last position AND the pair matches, replace it
-        if j < last and ids[j+1] == p1:
-            extend(ids[i:j])
-            append(idx)
-            i = j + 2
-            if same:
-                k -= 1 # ids[j+1] was an occurrence of p0 too
-        else:
-            extend(ids[i:j+1])
-            i = j + 1
-    extend(ids[i:])
-    return newids
+    p0, p1 = pair
+    # jump between occurrences of one token of the pair with list.index (in C)
+    # and copy the untouched runs between merged occurrences with slices
+    count = ids.count
+    k = count(p0) # occurrences of p0 left at >= pos
+    if not k:
+        return list(ids)
+    newids = []
+    extend = newids.extend
+    append = newids.append
+    index = ids.index
+    i = 0 # start of the not yet copied part of ids
+    pos = 0 # where to search for the next occurrence
+    if p0 != p1:
+        # occurrences cannot overlap, so they can be found via the rarer token
+        k1 = count(p1)
+        if not k1:
+            return list(ids)
+        if k1 < k:
+            while k1:
+                j = index(p1, pos)
+                k1 -= 1
+                if j > i and ids[j-1] == p0:
+                    extend(ids[i:j-1])
+                    append(idx)
+                    i = j + 1
+                pos = j + 1
+            extend(ids[i:])
+            return newids
+    last = len(ids) - 1
+    same = p0 == p1
+    while k:
+        j = index(p0, pos)
+        k -= 1
+        # if not at the very last position AND the pair matches, replace it
+        if j < last and ids[j+1] == p1:
+            extend(ids[i:j])
+            append(idx)
+            i = pos = j + 2
+            if same:
+                k -= 1 # ids[j+1] was an occurrence of p0 too
+        else:
+            pos = j + 1
+    extend(ids[i:])
+    return newids

actions.reason: Change to merge() (scan via rarer token, copy only on matches) kept outputs identical but made train_ir 3.6% worse (ratio 1.0360); the extra count() and branching probably cost more on the many small per-chunk merge calls in RegexTokenizer.train than they save on BasicTokenizer. No budget left to rework it, so not submitting.
